title: Practice Period 4 - Sandokai
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk is that true understanding of Zen cannot be found in words or concepts, but rather through direct experience and intuition. Instead of trying to define or grasp it intellectually, one must be willing to embrace uncertainty and trust in their own goodness and the goodness of others. This involves finding balance within the dynamic tension between opposing forces, such as light and darkness, and learning to navigate relationships with a sense of harmony and mutual understanding.
